pages.title: Explosive Shuriken
pages.text: Why settle for a simple cut when you can make it go boom? This throwing star is packed with TNT and explodes the moment it hits a creature or a block, damaging everything nearby and breaking blocks around the impact. Right click to throw it. It can be used 8 times, so choose your targets wisely!

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Place a Shuriken next to a block of TNT.
